item.text: I’ll use the AgentCAD tools to build the part, compare the four views, and export a single-solid STEP file.

The block proportions align closely with the reference. I’m adding the front bores and three rear vertical channels, then checking their positions in all four views.

The model is available in the [AgentCAD viewer](http://127.0.0.1:8773/#part.FCStd).

arguments.code:
result = cq.Workplane('XY').box(100,35,70)
# Four cross drilled ports
for x in [-30,-10,10,30]:
    tool=cq.Solid.makeCylinder(5.5,40,cq.Vector(x,-20,0),cq.Vector(0,1,0))
    result=result.cut(tool)
# Overlapping counterbores on front
for x in [-30,-10]:
    tool=cq.Solid.makeCylinder(14,3,cq.Vector(x,-17.5,0),cq.Vector(0,1,0))
    result=result.cut(tool)
# Three vertical half round channels on rear face
for x in [-10,0,10]:
    tool=cq.Solid.makeCylinder(5,72,cq.Vector(x,17.5,-36),cq.Vector(0,0,1))
    result=result.cut(tool)
arguments.label: Bores and rear channels
